description.zh: 要添加到防护对象组的防护对象。支持一次添加多个防护对象到防护对象组。多个防护对象之间使用英文逗号（,）分隔。
description.en: The protected objects to add to the protected object group. You can add multiple protected objects. Separate them with commas (,).

description.zh: 防护对象组描述信息。最大支持512个字符。
description.en: The description of the protected object group. The description can be up to 512 characters long.

description.zh: 要创建的防护对象组名称。长度为1~255个字符，可以包含中文、英文、数字、下划线（_）、半角句号（.）或者短划线（-）。
description.en: The name of the protected object group. The name must be 1 to 255 characters long and can contain Chinese characters, letters, digits, underscores (\_), periods (.), and hyphens (-).

description.zh:
WAF实例ID。

> 您可以通过调用[DescribeInstance](~~433756~~)接口查看当前WAF实例ID。
description.en:
The ID of the WAF instance.

> Call the [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) operation to view the ID of the WAF instance.

description.zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

- **cn-hangzhou**：表示中国内地。

- **ap-southeast-1**：表示非中国内地。
description.en:
The region where the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.
The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun waf-openapi create-defense-resource-group --instance-id waf_cdnsdf30000 --group-name group221 --add-list test1.aliyundoc.com,test2.aliyundoc.com --description test_domain --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-manager-resource-group-id rg-acfm000q --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun waf-openapi CreateDefenseResourceGroup --region cn-hangzhou --GroupName group221 --ResourceManagerResourceGroupId 'rg-acfm000q' --AddList 'test1.aliyundoc.com,test2.aliyundoc.com' --Description test_domain --InstanceId waf_cdnsdf30000 --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
